## Findings
- sympy-17630 (checkout 58e78209c8): `BlockMatrix([[a,Z],[Z,Z]])` repeated block-multiply crashed with `AttributeError: 'Zero' object has no attribute 'cols'`. Root cause: scalar `Add` postprocessor (matexpr.py `get_postprocessor`) built `MatAdd(S.Zero, *matrices)` when no scalar terms were present; `S.Zero` collapsed the MatAdd to a scalar during `doit`, so `dense._eval_matrix_mul` (Add(*vec)) put scalar `Zero` into the blocks grid.
- Fix applied = upstream commit a35bcc4559 (PR #17630): in `sympy/matrices/expressions/matexpr.py`, before the final return of `_postprocessor`, add `if mat_class == MatAdd: return mat_class(*matrices).doit(deep=False)`. 2 lines, source only.
- Verified: repro (block_collapse(b*b*b), b._blockmul(b)._blockmul(b), b*b*b*b) all work; bin/test on blockmatrix/matadd/matexpr/matmul = 86 passed, 3 xfail; full sympy/matrices = 476 passed, 2 failed + 16 exceptions which are PRE-EXISTING (identical stash-compare without fix; numpy 2.5 vs 2019 checkout).
- pytest on this checkout: test_matexpr/test_matmul fail at COLLECTION (`sympy/utilities/pytest.py:200 XFAIL = py.test.mark.xfail`, module 'py' has no attribute 'test') — pre-existing infra issue, use `bin/test` instead.

## Decisions
